title: L.R Panel Bed – Upholstered Panel Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The L.R Panel Bed is a stylish upholstered bed frame with a structured left-right panel headboard. Clean geometric lines deliver a modern, tailored look for contemporary bedrooms, and it is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Left-right structured panel headboard design
  • Generously padded premium upholstered headboard
  • Solid timber slatted base
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches so you can choose your colour with confidence

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £285.99; Small Double (4FT) £311.99; Double (4FT6) £324.99; King (5FT) £350.99; Super King (6FT) £402.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a solid wood frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, and custom requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress or the Memory Foam Mattress.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales), made by our own team, and usually takes 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland delivery is £90. You have 14 days to return an unused, unassembled item in its original packaging, with free collection. A faulty item is replaced or fully refunded. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What does the left-right panel design look like?

The headboard is a structured left-right panel design with clean geometric lines.

Can I choose stripes or two-tone fabric?

Yes. Solid colours, stripes and two-tone finishes are available, with custom fabric and colour options on request.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Can I see the fabric first?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can see the colour in your own light before ordering.
